Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
[D1:2] Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
[D1:3] Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
[D1:4] Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
[D1:5] Deborah: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[D1:8] Jolene: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it
[D1:9] Deborah: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?
[D1:10] Jolene: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
[D1:11] Deborah: It should really give you strength and energy!
[D1:12] Jolene: Do you have goals?
[D1:13] Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
[D1:14] Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
[D1:15] Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
[D1:16] Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
[D1:17] Deborah: Gotta run, bye!
[D1:18] Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!

[D2:16] Jolene: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?

[D2:18] Jolene: What other hobbies did your mother have?
[D2:19] Deborah: Travel was also her great passion!
[D2:20] Jolene: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.
[D2:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it
[D2:21] Deborah: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?
[D2:22] Jolene:  I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!
[D2:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket
[D2:23] Deborah: Awww, that's so nice! 
[D2:24] Jolene: I bought it a year ago in Paris.
[D2:25] Deborah: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!
[D2:26] Jolene: They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!
[D2:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv
[D2:27] Deborah: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?
[D2:28] Jolene: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.
[D2:29] Deborah: Do you only play old games or try new ones?
[D2:30] Jolene: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.
[D2:31] Deborah: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!
[D2:32] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!

[D15:4] Jolene: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.
[D15:5] Deborah: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?
[D15:6] Jolene: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you.
[D15:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer
[D15:7] Deborah:  What do you like best about gaming together?
[D15:8] Jolene: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.
[D15:9] Deborah: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?
[D15:10] Jolene: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?
[D15:11] Deborah: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth.
[D15:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D15:12] Jolene: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
[D15:13] Deborah: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
[D15:14] Jolene:  Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
[D15:15] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it.
[D15:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it
[D15:16] Jolene: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you.
[D15:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake on a branch with a book
[D15:17] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?
[D15:18] Jolene:  I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
[D15:19] Deborah:  Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
[D15:20] Jolene: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her.
[D15:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants
[D15:21] Deborah: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!
[D15:22] Jolene: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
[D15:23] Deborah: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.
[D15:24] Jolene: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy. 
[D15:25] Deborah: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.
[D15:25] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket
[D15:26] Jolene: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?
[D15:27] Deborah: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.
[D15:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:28] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
[D15:29] Deborah: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
[D15:30] Jolene: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
[D15:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:31] Deborah:  It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
[D15:32] Jolene: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this
[D15:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over a body of water
[D15:33] Deborah: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
[D15:34] Jolene: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
[D15:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background
[D15:35] Deborah: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.
[D15:36] Jolene: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
[D15:37] Deborah: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
[D15:38] Jolene: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
[D15:39] Deborah: We all need a timeout!
Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
[D16:2] Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
[D16:9] Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?

Session date: 2:18 pm on 12 September, 2023
[D27:1] Jolene: Hey Deb! So sorry for the late reply, been super busy. Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket. Amazing experience! Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace.
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D27:2] Deborah:  I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.
[D27:3] Jolene: At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy. It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies. The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!
[D27:4] Deborah:  Was there anything from the retreat that stood out to you?
[D27:5] Jolene: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present. It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too. I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.
[D27:6] Deborah:  I've been thinking about this a lot, too. Life's full of small moments and being grateful for those can really boost our happiness.
[D27:7] Jolene: Yup, totally agree! Sometimes we get too focused on the big stuff and don't appreciate all the tiny wins. Like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee - can be small but they make life much better. Trying to be more mindful and grateful to take it all in now.
[D27:8] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Practicing mindfulness and gratitude can really change our day-to-day. Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful. Glad you're getting into it!
[D27:9] Jolene: I'm experiencing a new level of joy and happiness!
[D27:10] Deborah:  It's wonderful to see your progress, and I'm excited to be on this journey with you!
[D27:11] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Appreciate your support. It's great that we can do this together.
[D27:12] Deborah: Having a supportive community definitely helps. We can motivate and encourage each other! By the way, I recently played a game. I don't remember what it's called. This is a card game about cats, where you take cards one by one from a deck, and then you can attack your opponent with them. We'll definitely play it with you!
[D27:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two children standing on yoga mats in a room
[D27:13] Jolene: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!
Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023

[D21:6] Jolene: My goal is to be successful in my field and make a positive impact. I've been studying, attending workshops, and networking to make it happen. Recently, I had the opportunity to present at a virtual conference and received positive feedback.  It was a great experience and confirmed that I'm on the right track.

I'm even thinking about more internships to further enhance my skills. Exciting times! Hopefully, there will be more updates to share with you soon.
[D21:9] Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Way to go! I'm super proud of all you've achieved. Let me know if you need any help. Onward!
[D21:10] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot to me.

Session date: 5:33 pm on 26 August, 2023
[D22:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, since we talked I've been thinking about my mom's influence. Remembering those we love is important.
[D22:2] Jolene: I understand, Deb. Remembering and cherishing the memories of our loved ones is so important. It's comforting to know that their influence still guides us. Last Friday, my partner and I talked about how our loved ones have influenced us and what their values meant to us. It was an emotional chat, but it made us feel closer and showed us what really matters. 
[D22:3] Deborah: Those types of conversations really help build relationships. Can you tell me more about the values they have given you?
[D22:4] Jolene: Definitely! Our loved ones have taught us to persevere and stay resilient, like my mom always said to never give up, and my partner's dad showed them to stay determined. Their values have influenced us to pursue our goals, such as me with engineering and my partner with their creative endeavors. Even though they're not here, we both feel their values encouraging us along our paths.
[D22:5] Deborah: That's wonderful to hear, Jolene! It's amazing how their values continue to guide you, even in their absence. It sounds like you and your partner are honoring their memory by pursuing your respective passions. Have you ever considered incorporating those values into your work as well?
[D22:6] Jolene: Yeah, Deborah! We've been figuring out how to add these values into our projects. As an engineering student, I want to use my talents to do good and help solve important problems. I'm keen on coming up with new ideas and making things more efficient to make the world a better place. Going further, my mom stressed the value of helping others and that's something I want to keep in mind for my engineering projects.
[D22:7] Deborah: When our work ties into our values, it becomes more meaningful. What goals or ideas do you have for incorporating those values into your future projects?
[D22:8] Jolene: In the future, I'm aiming to work on projects that make a real difference to communities. I'm interested in sustainable initiatives and developing innovative solutions for environmental issues. I also want to get involved with organizations that focus on social causes, using my skills to help out. It's about connecting my passion for engineering with my commitment to making a positive impact.
[D22:9] Deborah: You've got a lot of amazing plans for the future. Which projects are you most interested in getting involved in?
[D22:10] Jolene: I'm keen on two projects in particular. One is focused on developing renewable energy, like solar, to help communities and reduce dependence on non-renewables. 
[D22:11] Deborah: Wow Jolene, that's really inspiring!
[D22:12] Jolene: The other is finding ways to supply clean water to those with limited access. Both align with my beliefs about sustainability and assisting those in need. I still have so much to figure out before beginning, but I'm up for the challenge.
[D22:13] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! Research is key to success. Little steps and being up for challenges make you stronger. I'm here for you. Connecting to yourself helps tackle any issue. Here's a photo that reminds me of the beauty of nature during a yoga session.
[D22:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D22:14] Jolene: It helps with challenges, giving balance and strength. Any tips for staying relaxed while studying?
[D22:15] Deborah: Taking breaks, doing some stretching/yoga, or just going for a walk is really helpful. And don't forget to get enough sleep and take time for self-care. Finding a balance between work and taking care of yourself is important. What self-care activities have you been doing lately?
[D22:16] Jolene: I've been into yoga and meditation lately. It helps me recharge. Doing different poses relieves tension and calms my mind. I've already shared my newfound love for yoga with my partner, and we're planning to go on a meditation retreat together to enhance our practice together.
[D22:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose
[D22:17] Deborah: Glad to hear that yoga is helping you rest and recharge. It's great for reflection and self-care. Do your snakes also enjoy it?
[D22:18] Jolene: My snakes just like watching me chill. But she's a great company and always brings a sense of calm.
[D22:19] Deborah: Having a pet around is such a calming feeling. They sure can bring a great sense of comfort. I still have cats, Luna is sitting on the left.
[D22:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two cats sitting on a window sill looking out
[D22:20] Jolene: Aww, that's adorable! What's the second one's name?
[D22:21] Deborah: Max! They bring lots of joy and peace to our home.
[D22:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a brown leather chair and a black and white floor
[D22:22] Jolene: How did you get them?
[D22:23] Deborah: Max is my mother's cat, I took him when my mother passed away.
[D22:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a car with a fan and a mesh bag
[D22:24] Jolene: You're great for taming him. How did you get Luna?
[D22:25] Deborah: I took Luna from the shelter.
[D22:26] Jolene: It’s wonderful that you have become their loving owner!
[D22:27] Deborah: Yes, I really love cats, and they also need a home, love, and care! Moreover, Max is already old, he is 8 years old.
[D22:28] Jolene: How old is Luna?
[D22:29] Deborah: She is younger, she is 5 years old.
[D22:30] Jolene: I am proud of your action to tame these pets!
